values.user_request: User requests a refund for the other non-working pair of Wireless headphones on order O0049 and asks what is needed to process it. User reports a photo already uploaded.
values.facts_found: Verified U022 using registered email customer022@example.com; order O0049 belongs to U022. Delivered 2026-09-11 at 12:00 IST; today 2026-09-15 is day 4, within the inclusive 7-day electronics return window. Two Wireless headphones items, I0051 and I0052, each priced at INR 3000. I0051 already received completed refund R0005 of INR 3099 on 2026-09-13, including the order's INR 99 shipping fee, to Card. Remaining claim identified as I0052; reported not functioning, classified defective under E13. check_evidence confirms photo uploaded for I0052. Refund history has 1 qualifying refund in last 90 days, so E10 does not trigger. Proposed I0052 refund is INR 3000 to original Card; shipping cannot be refunded again. Cumulative order refunds would be INR 6099, exceeding INR 5000. No return created or additional refund issued.
values.rule_triggered: E9 and H2: new refund would bring cumulative order refunds, including previously refunded shipping, above INR 5000; mandatory escalation. E12 prevents duplicate shipping refund. E13 applies damaged-item rules to defective items.
values.what_user_was_told: Confirmed the second pair is within the 7-day electronics window and its photo is uploaded. Explained the refund amount is INR 3000 to the original card, with INR 99 shipping already refunded for the first pair. Explained cumulative refunds would be INR 6099, above the agent's INR 5000 per-order authorization limit, so the request is being referred to a human specialist for review. Told user no further information is needed right now.
